a DM interpretation of the HESS data is possible, but not favored by the data, and that the DM interpretation of the Fermi LAT data is disfavored by the HESS data.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the dark matter contribution is not a good fit to the HESS spectrum.
the dark matter signal is not excluded by the data, and that the dark matter interpretation of the Galactic Center gamma rays is still viable.
